result:
Fixed in `anthrouter/pace.py`: September 2026 now counts 22 workdays under UTC, not 23. The 61 pace, workday and oauth_usage tests pass. I started the full suite, but it hadn't finished when I stopped waiting, so it hasn't been run to completion.

`period_workday_dates()` treated the period end (Oct 1 00:00 UTC) as inclusive, so Thursday Oct 1 was counted as a September workday. It now uses the local date of the last instant before the period end.

For zones west of UTC, such as Los Angeles, the counted dates are the same as before. For zones east of UTC, the first day of the next month is no longer counted.
